title: 第1345章 正式收徒了第1344章 始魔祖体
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
回到暂时居住的地方！
面无表情的英格丽德，此时手里提着那个，还没恢复意识的魔族小鬼，将其轻轻放在一张躺椅之上！
“主人！”
“您之前在那个山坳里说，还能让我的魔心再次升华提高，具体的到底应该怎么做？！”
在得到自己的魔心，还能更进一步之后！
回来的路上英格丽德就一直强忍着心头急切的好奇，当到暂住地就迫不及待的开口询问更多细节！
听到询问的青墨，他刚继续坐回自己的摇椅上，转头就看向被英格丽德放置在躺椅上的魔族小鬼，眼神深邃让人难懂！
说实话！
原本这次他们一群人来到琉素神域，这个魔族小鬼的突然出现，完全是在青墨的预料之外！
这次他亲自带人过去，将这个魔族小鬼带回来，说白了就是为了他身上携带的某个东西！
不过当时青墨位于山坳云层之上，在彻底清楚的感觉到，对方觉醒的始魔祖体之后，他这才临时改变自身的想法！
原本青墨的打算是，找到这个随身携带自己所需之物的小鬼，先把东西拿到手里之后，再让英格丽德将其魔气彻底吞噬干净！
不过，始魔祖体毕竟亿万年难得一见，就这么当成一次性耗材的话，未免太过暴谴天物！
“这个小鬼所觉醒的体质，实在太过于罕见！”
“之前你和他动手的时候，他完全因为体质的原因而处于心智错乱的状态，所释放出的那些看似浓烈，实际上还并未达到至精至纯的魔气！”
“同样也因为他现在，无法完全掌控这个亿万年难得一见的魔体，所以他极易进入狂暴嗜血的癫狂状态！”
“想要让你的魔心更进一步，达到与他这个魔体同样的级别。最好是等他完全能掌控这个魔体，能释放至精至纯的本源魔气之后！”
“到时，你再将他所释放的那些，最为精纯的本源魔气完全吸收，并且将之全部凝聚到你的魔心深处，使得魔心本源与之完全彻底相融！”
“当你的魔心，相融他足够多的精纯本源魔气之后……！”
青墨此时淡淡开口解释，虽说他最后并没有把话全部说完，不过一旁的英格丽德和赤井玛丽二人，也全都听懂了！

“男主人！既然这样的话，我们那干嘛不…？！”
“我知道你的意思！”
听到坐在自己身旁赤井玛丽的话，青墨抬手轻轻捏了捏她那圆润的良心！
“如此难得一见的体质，杀了过于可惜！”
“再说了，想要让英格丽德的魔心更进一步，不过是需要始魔祖体的本源魔气而已！”
“这种东西又不是说用了就没有了！只要魔体还在，哪怕多花一些时间恢复，它依旧能源源不绝！”
听着青墨的话，再看了看躺在躺椅上的魔族小鬼，英格丽德眼中眸光微微一闪，而后轻轻点了点头！
刚才她也是和赤井玛丽一样想法，都打算将眼前的魔族小鬼，当成自己继续成长的一次性耗材！
看着青墨打算帮英格丽德再次提升体质，心中同样涌现浓郁渴望的赤井玛丽，她轻轻咬了咬自己的下嘴唇后！
只见其缓缓捂住青墨的一只大手，而后将它放在自己的脸上，赤井玛丽整个人缓缓跪在了青墨的面前！
“男主人！”
“怎么了，玛丽？是椅子坐着不舒服，非要跪地上？还是说你做错事了？！”
“不是！男主人！您看您现在已经帮英格丽德开始提升体质，那我能不能也……？！”
“你…你怎么？！虽说你是贝贝的仆从，同时也是我的专属灭火器！可是从始至终，我好像都没亏待过你，该给你的顶级神体也已经给了吧？！”
垂眸看着跪在自己面前的赤井玛丽，青墨此时眼神里满是审视之意！
“男主人！我是说，如果…如果可以的话，能不能也请您将我的体质，再给…提一提？！”
微微仰头，眸光中透露着渴望与哀求的赤井玛丽，此时正眼巴巴的看着面前的青墨！
闻言，青墨嘴角微勾！
他对着跪在自己面前的赤井玛丽，轻轻勾了勾手指！
“之前给你的鼎炉体质已经很不错了！”
content_en:
Return to your temporary residence!
With an expressionless face, Ingrid was holding the demon kid in her hand, who had not yet regained consciousness, and gently placed it on a recliner!
"Master!"
"You said before in that mountain col that you could make my demonic heart sublime and improve again. How should you do it specifically?!"
After getting your own demon heart, you can go one step further!
On the way back, Ingrid suppressed her eager curiosity, and when she arrived at her temporary residence, she couldn't wait to ask for more details!
When Qing Mo heard the question, he just continued to sit back in his rocking chair, then turned to look at the demon kid placed on the recliner by Ingrid, his eyes were so deep that it was hard to understand!
to be honest!
Originally, a group of them came to the Liusu Divine Realm this time, and the sudden appearance of this devil kid was completely unexpected by Qing Mo!
This time he personally led people there and brought back this devil kid. To put it bluntly, it was for something he carried!
However, Qing Mo was located above the clouds in the mountain col at that time. After he completely and clearly felt that the opponent had awakened the ancestral body of the First Demon, he temporarily changed his mind!
Qing Mo's original plan was to find this kid who was carrying what he needed, get the things in his hands first, and then let Ingrid completely swallow up his demonic energy!
However, after all, the ancestral body of the First Demon is rare to see for hundreds of millions of years. If it is treated as a disposable consumable, it would be too much to condemn a natural creature!
"The physique that this kid has awakened is really too rare!"
"When you fought with him before, he was in a state of mental confusion due to his physical condition. The demonic energy he released seemed strong, but in fact it was not the most refined and pure demonic energy!"
"It's also because he can't fully control this devilish body that has been rare in billions of years, so he can easily enter a violent and bloodthirsty state of madness!"
"If you want to take your demonic heart one step further and reach the same level as his demonic body, it's best to wait until he can fully control this demonic body and release the most refined and pure original demonic energy!"
"At that time, you will completely absorb the purest original demonic energy he released, and condense it all into the depths of your demonic heart, so that the origin of the demonic heart can be completely integrated with it!"
"When your demonic heart merges with enough of his pure original demonic energy...!"
Qing Mo explained calmly at this time. Although he did not finish all the words in the end, Ingrid and Akai Mari understood everything!
"Master! If that's the case, why don't we...?!"
"I know what you mean!"
Hearing the words of Akai Mari sitting next to him, Qing Mo raised his hand and gently pinched her round conscience!
"With such a rare physique, it would be a pity to kill him!"
"Besides, if you want to take Ingrid's demonic heart a step further, you just need the original demonic energy from the ancestral body of the First Demon!"
"This kind of thing doesn't mean it will disappear after use! As long as the demon body is still there, even if it takes more time to recover, it will still have an endless supply of energy!"
After listening to Qing Mo's words, and looking at the demon kid lying on the couch, Ingrid's eyes flashed slightly, and then she nodded slightly!
Just now, she had the same idea as Akai Marie, planning to treat the demon kid in front of her as a disposable consumable for her continued growth!
Seeing Qing Mo planning to help Ingrid improve her physique again, Akai Mari felt a strong desire in her heart. She gently bit her lower lip!
I saw him slowly covering one of Qing Mo's big hands, and then putting it on his face. Akai Marie slowly knelt down in front of Qing Mo!
"Master!"
"What's wrong, Mary? Is it because the chair is uncomfortable and you have to kneel on the floor? Or are you doing something wrong?!"
"No! Master! You see you have helped Ingrid drive the car now!"If I start to improve my physique, can I also...? ! "
"You...how are you? ! Although you are Beibei's servant, you are also my exclusive fire extinguisher! But from the beginning to the end, it seems that I have never treated you badly. I have already given you the top-level divine body, right? ! "
Looking down at Akai Mari who was kneeling in front of him, Qing Mo's eyes were full of scrutiny!
"Master! I mean, if... if possible, could you please also mention... my physique? ! "
Akai Mari, who raised her head slightly, with longing and pleading in her eyes, was looking longingly at Qing Mo in front of her!
Hearing this, the corners of Qingmo's mouth curled up slightly!
He gently hooked his fingers at Akai Marie who was kneeling in front of him!
“The cauldron physique I gave you before is already very good! "
